execution_rulings: Ruling: Execute this necessary complete-input subsystem inline under the already approved official-code/full-paper route and server/publication authorization — no new user preference or experimental architecture is introduced — cost if wrong: a labelled admission subsystem needs correction, never silent change to old results.

Ruling: Preserve explicit unified-stat substitution and old filtered aliases from reviewed reader; full content checks cannot upgrade them to merged-source/train-only/PDF equivalence — actual source records and known namespace failure remain binding — cost if wrong: data-version or pooled-stat mismatch can bias later comparison, which remains separately labelled.

Ruling: Full input qualification still does not complete scientific fusion; trained-branch provenance, GPU/recovery/full150epoch/selection/test/report remain required — this is the actual next prerequisite, not a substitute result — cost if wrong: a later integration defect may remain untested and completed model count must not increase now.

Ruling: Correct the prior future-work wording that required both initializer branches to be validation-best: canonical f7fusion config explicitly names vision last.ckpt and EMG best.ckpt, so preserve those declared roles for own trained initializers, while final fusion selection still uses independent validation best — source priority in approved spec overrides the plan shorthand; this does not infer unpublished author-file internals — cost if wrong: own last may be a weaker warm start and cannot prove byte-equivalence to author weights; retain explicit provenance and adaptation limits. No prior result or running source is changed.

Ruling: Reject unknown or stale shared LMDB environments rather than closing another consumer cache or accepting a current path hash for an old mapping; standalone qualification workers are already fresh processes — reason: existing shared reader has no inode-generation witness — cost: callers that warmed a crop through another adapter must use a fresh admission process, while unchanged registered same-process reopen remains supported.

Ruling: Reviewer declined unchanged construction/joint-reader/sharedStatGuard/range-control/live-job correctness; preserve their frozen sources and own separate evidence rather than expanding this review — cost: this review cannot certify those implementations, no original healthy owner is restarted.

Ruling: Reviewer declined publisher authentication, physically merged corpus, PDF equivalence and pooled-norm suitability; keep all explicit limitations and false eligibility flags — cost: this admission cannot claim paper numerical equivalence.

Ruling: Reviewer declined exhaustive JPEG decode/image semantics; retain complete crop byte hashes plus original fatal decode behavior — cost: a bad image may only be discovered when consumed, before scientific completion it must be handled without silent sample drops.

Ruling: Reviewer declined GPU capacity, trained initializers, recovery, full fit, selection and report; these remain mandatory future work — cost: current scientific completed-setting count remains10.

Ruling: Reviewer declined finiteness after stochastic transforms/model execution; raw full possible footprints remain this task scope — cost: real GPU training still needs its own finite forward/backward/update qualification.

Ruling: Reviewer declined automatic checks inside later loader iteration; maintain explicit checks at admission/loader boundaries and require future fit integration — cost: this module alone cannot protect an unchecked later long-running fit.

Ruling: Reviewer declined malicious replacement of private methods/guards; this is a trusted task API, not a process security boundary — cost: hostile in-process code can defeat private state and is outside the scientific provenance claim.
